ownerEvidence.action: Let the single owner legacy-price subscription lapse (cancel_at_period_end, ends 2026-09-01) or cancel it now, then fire billing-reconcile once so cron_billing_reconcile_freshness=ok in paid readiness.
ownerEvidence.note: ROOT CAUSE (revised 2026-09-05 after a real reconcile run): the only subscription is the owner's own (user 688ba16f, sub_1TzahD...) on a legacy Stripe price (price_1TxjJI...) the current catalog no longer maps. A live billing-reconcile POST on 2026-09-05 fixed the status drift (active->canceled to match Stripe) but STILL returned ok:false with unknownPrices=[price_1TxjJI...]. The earlier 'self-resolves once the sub ends 2026-09-01' assumption was WRONG: reconcile counted the canceled sub's historical price into unknownPrices because the check ran against every subscription row regardless of status, so it would false-fail on every future run and permanently pin cron_billing_reconcile_freshness=unavailable. FIX (owner-authorized real bug fix): src/lib/stripe/reconcile.ts now scopes the unknownPrices check to LIVE_STATUSES via isUnknownActivePrice() (trialing/active/past_due/unpaid) so a terminal sub's dead price no longer fails reconcile; an unmapped price on a live sub is still flagged. Remaining owner action: REDEPLOY the fix, then fire one billing-reconcile run -> expect ok:true and a durable cron_runs success -> cron_billing_reconcile_freshness=ok. Only gates live paid; capped beta is unaffected.
